name: popup
title: Popup chrome
description: Shared popup chrome for the dropdown, select, and combobox popups: side-aware enter/exit motion classes driven by the positioner's resolved data-side, the ScrollArea sizing the list scrolls inside, the navigation-key list, and the clear layer that keeps the page from reacting to the pointer while a popup is open.
docs: Docs & live playground: https://www.fluidfunctionalism.com/docs/motion. Craft notes, the color, layout and motion decisions to keep when you change it: https://github.com/mickadesign/fluid-functionalism/blob/main/skills/fluid-functionalism/references/craft.md#motion.
